A video of an Indian Army commando has gone viral on social media ahead of the encounter with Lashkar commander Lateef Bhat in Kulgam. Armed with an AK-203 and displaying remarkable confidence, the soldier has sparked a debate online. While some users are praising his personality and aura, others have raised questions over alleged excesses in Kashmir. But who is this commando? What is 9 Para Special Forces, known as the Pirates and Mountain Rats?
